title: Outgrow The World | Reebok Ai Concept Ad | Nano Banana Pro + Kling + Suno + ElevenLabs
shortDescription: Proof-of-concept narrative advertising built on a "based on a true story" model.
longDescription:
Concept Overview: "Based on a True Story" Narrative Advertising Model

This project was developed as a proof-of-concept for a deeper form of advertising, one that moves beyond traditional commercial structure and into cinematic narrative storytelling.

The framework is built around a "based on a true story" model.

For this piece, the character was inspired by the life arc of Shaquille O'Neal. The story pulls from publicly known elements of his journey, early adversity, relentless work ethic, development through high school and LSU, and the eventual rise to professional success.

The objective was not to recreate an exact likeness, but to demonstrate how real-life narratives can be structured into emotionally driven, documentary-style concept ads.

This was not a quick process.

It required:

- Research into biographical elements
- Musical structuring to establish emotional pacing
- Storyboarding to narrative beats
- Iterative generation and refinement of visual sequences
- Assembly into a cohesive timeline

The project was executed on a minimal budget, in between other active productions, primarily to demonstrate possibility.

What this represents is the floor, not the ceiling.

With:

- A small, focused creative team
- Locked script development
- Dedicated editing and sound design
- Licensed likeness rights
- A defined production timeline and budget

This model can evolve into:

- High-end biographical concept trailers
- Brand campaigns rooted in real founder stories
- Legacy storytelling pieces for athletes and public figures
- Deeply personalized documentary-style advertising
- Historical recreations with emotional weight

The pace of generative tools is accelerating rapidly. Every few months, the realism and control improve significantly. That means the scalability of this model increases over time.

This project demonstrates that narrative-driven, emotionally resonant concept advertising can now be developed with a level of speed and flexibility that was previously inaccessible.

title: Afterlight Zero
shortDescription: A dystopian teaser trailer engineered for story continuity and cinematic escalation.
longDescription:
This trailer project proves short-form AI storytelling can still feel authored. We mapped sequence beats first, then generated every scene to match camera language and emotional trajectory.

The system was tuned to preserve character identity and spatial logic, even across radically different set pieces.

title: Founders in Motion
shortDescription: Brand story campaign that translates founder interviews into cinematic story ads.
longDescription:
We transformed founder voice notes into a visual campaign with consistent tone and brand texture. This project focused on repeatability: one pipeline, multiple ad variants, no drop in narrative quality.

The final system lets teams spin new ads quickly while preserving production value.

title: AI for Real Life Classroom
shortDescription: Educational visual series showing practical AI production workflows for creators.
longDescription:
This content system teaches creators how to move from random prompting to structured production. We designed each lesson around outcomes, not tools.

The result is a repeatable curriculum that helps teams generate realistic, continuity-safe work faster.

title: Memory of Water
shortDescription: Experimental short exploring fluid transformations with tightly art-directed prompts.
longDescription:
A visual poem built around transitions that feel physically plausible, even when surreal. The project served as an R&D space for motion continuity and texture behavior.

Findings from this experiment now feed directly into branded and narrative client work.

title: Launch Day Signal
shortDescription: Short-form product launch campaign tuned for retention and conversion.
longDescription:
We built this project around one objective: move from scroll to action in under five seconds. Scripts, visuals, and cuts were all iterated against retention checkpoints.

The final package balances creative edge with measurable marketing outcomes.

title: Maiden Voyage Prequel(Finalish)
shortDescription: Client music video project from mid-2025 focused on early AI realism and character consistency.
longDescription:
This project was created in June and July of 2025 for a client who reached out and asked me to produce a music video using their likeness.

It represents a snapshot of where my AI video skills and the available technology were at that time.

The main challenges were maintaining character consistency and achieving realism, both of which were just starting to become possible with AI tools back then.

title: The Last of My Kind Music Video Short
shortDescription: September 2025 creative test focused on first/last frame control, lip-sync, and consistent AI character storytelling.
longDescription:
This music video sample was created in September 2025 as a creative test of emerging AI video tools.

The focus was on exploring first and last frame generation, improving lip-sync performance, and experimenting with storytelling through consistent AI characters.

It served as both a technical study and a creative experiment to see how these features could be used to bring emotion and realism into AI-driven music videos.

title: Life of the Lazy Man — S1 E1 (Prequel)
shortDescription: Season 1, Episode 1 of the Life of the Lazy Man vertical series — a prequel episode built for the short-form vertical format that's redefining how stories get told.
longDescription:
This is Season 1, Episode 1 of the Life of the Lazy Man vertical series — and the prequel that sets it all in motion.

The vertical series format is one of the fastest-growing storytelling mediums right now, built natively for how people actually consume content. This project leans into that shift, using Kling to craft a cinematic episode designed specifically for the 9:16 screen.

This prequel establishes the world, the character, and the tone for everything that follows in the series.
